sections.title: Chaining what you already know
sections.content: A real eating habit is just a frequency word plus eszik or iszik in its ordinary, indefinite form — nothing new here, just the last two lessons put together. hetente, naponta and the -szor/-szer/-ször numbers all slot in front of eszem/eszel/eszik... and iszom/iszol/iszik... exactly the way they slot in front of any other verb.

items.english: I eat meat three times a week.

items.spanish: Naponta kétszer iszom kávét, reggel és délután.
items.english: I drink coffee twice a day, in the morning and in the afternoon.
How many times a week do you eat vegetables?

sections.content: Word order stays flexible here, same as always — Hetente háromszor eszem húst and Húst eszem hetente háromszor both work, with whatever comes first getting a little more emphasis.
